Control Room.description: The hub of the plant. Monitors flicker with amber warnings.

Turbine Hall.description: A massive cavernous room filled with the roar of steam turbines.

Maintenance Closet.description: A cramped room smelling of oil and ozone.

Reactor Core.description: The air glows blue with Cherenkov radiation. Heat is intense.

Cooling Pump Station.description: High-pressure pipes vibrate underfoot. A leak is spraying steam.
